description: Record/replay script for a 2-page LJCMG CapHome enforcement search whose SHARED record (?id=shared) appears on BOTH pages (LJCMGClient.cs:75-175 + HistoricalCrawler goToNextPageCallback :81-105). form → page1 → page2 (last). The search click and the pagination click each emit a POST to CapHome.aspx (the postback waitForRequest matches). page1 carries the pagination anchor (hasMorePages true); page2 does not (hasMorePages false → last page). All results states report the same CapHome.aspx url, so the row-url scheme/host resolve to https://aca-prod.accela.com and the two ?id=shared rows produce the identical url — exercising the result's distinct(...) de-dup (the reference HashSet<string> newLinks). No Chromium, no live traffic.
